title: Reel Adventures Inc

services.name: Our charters
services.desc: Experience the adrenaline-pumping action of big game fishing, from just two miles off the shore out to the Gulf Stream. What makes Miami unique is how close the deep water sits. The ocean floor drops off just a few miles from the coast, so the Gulf Stream and true offshore fishing start minutes from the dock. We run to the edge of the Stream and troll rigged baits and lures along weed lines and temperature breaks. This is the run-and-gun pelagic fishing Miami's known for, covering water until we find the fish, then putting baits in front of them. More water time means more shots, so it shines on a 3/4 or full day. Mahi peak spring-summer; wahoo and tuna run the cooler months. Best on a 3/4
